title: Switching the lite-mode trade screen to a token payment method keeps one funding message and a reachable action button
description: Proves TAT-3742: after switching the payment method from the Perps balance to a wallet token, the lite-mode Perps trade screen no longer stacks contradictory funding errors and no longer pushes the place-order button out of the viewport.

setup-status.intent: Confirm the mobile bridge is reachable before driving the UI

setup-unlock.intent: Make the fixture wallet usable so Perps screens can render live data

setup-open-market.intent: Open the SOL perps market where a trade can be started

setup-wait-long.intent: The SOL market screen is ready for a trader to start a long trade

setup-press-long.intent: Start a long trade so the lite-mode order screen opens

setup-wait-order-screen.intent: The trader has arrived on the lite-mode order screen

setup-open-pay-sheet.intent: The trader opens the payment method chooser

setup-wait-pay-sheet.intent: The payment method chooser offers a wallet token to pay with

setup-reset-to-perps-balance.intent: Start from the default Perps balance so the later switch is a real change of payment method

setup-reopen-pay-sheet.intent: The trader opens the payment method chooser again

setup-wait-pay-sheet-again.intent: The payment method chooser again offers a wallet token to pay with

setup-select-token.intent: The trader switches from the Perps balance to paying with a wallet token

ac1-assert-no-perps-balance-warning.intent: The trader is never told their Perps balance is empty while they are paying with a wallet token
ac1-assert-no-perps-balance-warning.text: Not enough funds available. Deposit funds or select a different payment method

ac1-assert-no-zero-available-row.intent: The trader is never shown a funding figure of zero that contradicts the balance they just picked

ac2-assert-action-button-visible.intent: The button that places the trade is still part of the screen after the payment method changes

ac1-screenshot-single-message.intent: The trade screen a trader sees straight after switching payment method, with the action button back in reach
ac1-screenshot-single-message.label: AC1 + AC2: one funding message at most, place-order button inside the viewport

ac2-assert-button-still-visible.intent: The action button survives the payment switch settling rather than being torn out of the screen

ac3-ac4-run-funding-state-tests.intent: The unresolved-to-resolved wallet-token transition is checked at the layer where a trader-facing render pass can be reproduced deterministically
ac3-ac4-run-funding-state-tests.cmd: yarn jest app/components/UI/Perps/Views/PerpsOrderView/PerpsOrderView.test.tsx -t 'unresolved pay-token balance' --runInBand --coverage=false --forceExit > temp/tasks/fix/34789-0825-085413/artifacts/funding-state-tests.log 2>&1; status=$?; cat temp/tasks/fix/34789-0825-085413/artifacts/funding-state-tests.log; exit $status

ac3-ac4-assert-funding-state-tests.intent: A same-source cached capacity keeps the slider usable during refresh, while a new unresolved source cannot borrow Perps capacity and Place Order stays fail-closed

teardown-index-test-log.intent: Keep the funding-state test output alongside the on-device evidence

artifacts.label: AC3: wallet-token balance transition test output
